hypothesis: A low-capacity patient RNA context can alter the interpretation of frozen TITAN CRC morphology concepts.

representation.image: Phase6A official TITAN semantic patient representation, frozen
representation.text: Phase6A official TITAN zero-shot text prototypes for 32 outcome-blind CRC morphology concepts, frozen
representation.dynamic_prompt: output-space prompt basis and gate; this is a frozen-encoder adapter, not token-level TITAN prompt tuning
representation.rna: fold-local log2(x+1), variance-top-512, standardization fit only on inner-train or outer-train, then Linear(512,16)

schedule.class_weighting: inverse frequency from inner-train or outer-train

wrong_patient_control: At outer-test only, cyclically derange RNA within the test fold; use the same matched model and image representation.
publication_storage: Only scripts, config, aggregate metrics, paired summaries, and validation are publishable. Patient OOF files, embeddings, RNA matrices, raw clinical tables, H5 files, and weights stay off GitHub.
